create_simple_vit_model: create a SimpleViT model for image classification with configurable patch size and transformer depth
build_transformer_blocks: build a Transformer module with stacked Attention and FeedForward layers for sequence modeling
create_attention_heads: create a multi-head Attention module with query-key-value projections and softmax weighting
generate_sincos_position_embeddings: generate 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for a grid of height and width dimensions
run_vit_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SimpleViT to classify an image tensor into num_classes categories
